fields.statement: The usage-settings acceptance updates the existing cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/usage-settings.txtar instead of adding a new one: it shows the three keys with defaults and machine scope, sets each and finds it in the root's rhiza.toml rather than git config, still rejects a reserve outside 0-100 and a non-number limit with exit 2, and regenerates describe-golden.txtar.
fields.wording: Update the existing usage-settings.txtar to cover the settings moving to the machine-wide rhiza.toml; the agent's option, picked by the owner
